full_prompt_en: A square illuminated bestiary page fills the frame with animals, birds, and tiny natural specimens arranged across aged cream parchment. A narrow ornamental border runs around all four sides, built from teal, rust red, and ochre bands with small repeating floral marks. Inside it, the page has no single horizon or landscape setting; each creature occupies its own pocket of pale space within a dense all-over arrangement. Near the upper edge, small winged forms and compact mammals line up between curled decorative marks. At upper left, a blue circular medallion encloses a curled creature, while the upper right holds a tawny reclining lion and a dark bird. Through the middle, a long blue fishlike creature stretches horizontally from left to right, with a broad fin dropping beneath it and a forked tail near the far edge. Smaller shells, insects, curled shapes, and colored specimens cluster around that central form. At middle left, a reddish stocky animal stands above a large tawny bearlike figure. On the right, a seated golden feline faces outward, with a darker rounded birdlike form beside it. In the lower left, a huge blue-gray rhinoceros-like animal carries much of the page's visual weight; thick legs and a blunt head are worked in closely layered strokes. Along the bottom and lower center, much smaller birds, a pale horned animal, shells, and creeping red forms fill the remaining gaps. The creatures vary in scale rather than sharing a single realistic depth, so the page reads as a collected visual inventory. Lighting is flat and even, like pigment resting on parchment, with shallow dark modeling within each figure and no cast shadow tying them to a ground plane. Fine ink contours, stippling, and warm granular wear soften the saturated blue, ochre, rust, and brown colors. Tiny marks near some specimens are too small to read. The overall composition is crowded yet carefully distributed, using varied silhouettes and a disciplined border to turn natural variety into an ornate, curious manuscript image.
full_prompt_zh: 一页方形彩绘兽谱占满画框，动物、鸟类和微小自然标本排列在老旧奶油色羊皮纸上。四周围着一道狭窄装饰边框，由青蓝、锈红与赭黄色带及细小重复花纹构成。边框内部没有单一地平线或风景背景；每个生物都在密集铺陈的布局中占据一小片浅色空间。上缘附近，小型带翅形体和紧凑的哺乳动物排在卷曲装饰记号之间。左上方，一个蓝色圆形饰章圈住蜷曲生物；右上方则有一只黄褐色卧狮和一只深色鸟。画面中部，一条长长的蓝色鱼形生物从左向右横穿，大鳍从身下垂落，分叉尾巴接近远侧边缘。较小的贝壳、昆虫、卷曲形状和彩色标本环绕中央形体。中部左侧，一只红褐色敦实动物站在一头大型黄褐色熊形动物上方。右侧，一只金色坐姿猫科动物面向画外，旁边是较暗的圆形鸟状物。左下方，一头巨大的蓝灰色犀牛状动物承担画面的主要视觉重量，粗腿和钝头由紧密叠加的笔痕描绘。底部和下方中央，较小的鸟、浅色有角动物、贝壳以及匍匐的红色形体填满余下空隙。动物大小各异，却不共享单一写实纵深，因此整页更像收集起来的视觉目录。光线平坦均匀，如颜料附在羊皮纸上，每个形体内部只有浅浅的深色塑形，没有把它们系在地面上的投影。细墨线轮廓、点描和暖色颗粒磨损柔化了饱和的蓝、赭、锈红与棕色。部分标本旁的细小记号无法辨认。整体构图拥挤却分配谨慎，以多样剪影和严整边框把自然的丰富性化为华美而引人好奇的手抄本图像。
style_prompt_en: The illuminated manuscript image uses fine ink outlines, flat mineral-like color, and aged parchment grain. Many separate shapes share one shallow plane, held together by a continuous ornamental border and small repeating marks. Scale can vary freely, with a few large dark or cool masses acting as anchors among numerous smaller warm accents. Teal blue, ochre, rust red, muted brown, and cream retain a slightly weathered, matte appearance. Narrow hatching and stippling add local volume without creating a single directional light or natural cast shadows. Edges remain carefully drawn yet uneven enough to preserve the handmade quality of pigment and ink. Open pockets of pale ground prevent the dense distribution from becoming a solid mass, while repeated circular and curling motifs tie distant areas together. The overall effect is encyclopedic and decorative, combining precise miniature detail with a lively, almost playful rhythm across the full surface.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩绘手抄本图像使用细墨线轮廓、近似矿物颜料的平涂色彩和老旧羊皮纸颗粒。许多分离的形状共享同一浅层平面，由连续装饰边框和细小重复记号维系在一起。尺度可以自由变化，少数大型深色或冷色体块在众多较小的暖色重音之间充当锚点。青蓝、赭黄、锈红、低饱和棕与奶油色保持略经风化的哑光外观。狭窄排线和点描提供局部体积，却不形成统一的定向光或自然投影。边缘绘制谨慎，又保留足够的不均匀性，使颜料和墨线的手工品质清楚可见。浅色底面的小片空隙防止密集分布凝成整块，反复出现的圆形与卷曲纹样则把远隔区域联系起来。整体效果兼具目录感与装饰性，将精细的微型细节与遍及整幅表面的活泼节奏结合。
theme_en: An illuminated bestiary page filled with animals and tiny natural specimens
theme_zh: 一页布满动物和微小自然标本的彩绘兽谱
name: Medieval Bestiary
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
